title: Soldiers and officers confirm the giant story to Alberino

tellings.quote: I've interacted with a handful of people um some soldiers, others officers that have confirmed to me that a that story is true and b there are even wilder stories and there are more giants out there than just one obviously.

plain: Soldiers and officers are said to have privately confirmed the story of a twelve-foot giant captured by US forces in Afghanistan. A researcher named Tim Alberino, who tells that giant story, says on the show that 'a handful of people,' some soldiers and some officers, told him it is true, that 'there are even wilder stories,' and that there is more than one giant out there. If true, giant humanlike beings would be living today and known to the military.
